Jordan (PM): Heads-up: new mock for the pool picker — trying to surface min/max, burst, and a small 'density' indicator that suggests SLO fit. Need quick feedback before design sync at 3pm. https://figma.com/file/xyz :eyes:
Sara (Designer): Nice. Quick thought: 'density' might confuse folks. What about 'expected throughput' or 'supporting SLO' copy?
Mike (SRE): From infra: if we show burst as 'available' we should indicate transient nature. Maybe add tiny badge 'burst (best-effort)'.
Leah (A11y): Accessibility: ensure the SLO slider has aria values and keyboard scrubbing. Suggest `aria-label="SLO slider, adjust target latency"` and visible focus ring.
Eve (PM Research): We ran microtests — wording 'expected throughput' aligned better with developer mental model. Users interpreted 'density' as memory usage.
Jordan (PM): Good call. Sara can we try: label 'Expected QPS' — then subcopy 'based on current pool and SLO'. Keep it short.
Sara (Designer): Try: 'Expected QPS (approx) — based on chosen pool, SLO, and burst settings.' Keep 'approx' for uncertainty.
Mike (SRE): One more infra ask: when pool picker auto-suggests a smaller pool due to cost, show an inline CTA 'pin capacity' so they don't get surprise rollbacks.
Jordan (PM): :thumbsup: agree. Leah, will that CTA be keyboard accessible?
Leah (A11y): Yes but ensure it's in DOM order and has `role='button'` + `aria-pressed` for toggled state. Also color contrast on the 'burst' tag is low in the mock — needs 4.5:1.
Sara (Designer): Noted — will bump contrast and add focus outline. Also propose a tooltip that appears on hover/focus: 'Burst gives temporary extra GPUs for short spikes, not guaranteed for sustained load.'
design-bot: Design checklist: tooltip + aria + contrast updated in figma. Updated file: https://figma.com/file/abc (v3).
Jordan (PM): Decision: change 'density' -> 'Expected QPS (approx)', add '(best-effort)' small badge for burst, add 'pin capacity' CTA. Sara to update mock and copy. Mike to validate labels with infra team. Leah to sign off a11y.
Sara (Designer): On it. Quick copy options for the microcopy area (3 variants):
1) 'Expected QPS (approx) — based on pool, SLO and burst.'
2) 'Estimated throughput — current pool & SLO.'
3) 'Projected requests/sec (approx) — subject to burst availability.'
Which is preferred?
Eve (PM Research): 1) or 3). Prefer 'requests/sec' for clarity in some customers.
Jordan (PM): Lean 1) but if we can A/B test copy, include 3) in the experiment.
Mike (SRE): Infra note: bursting consumes reserved capacity quota; add small footnote for enterprise tenants.
Leah (A11y): I'll run quick keyboard/focus tests after Sara updates. ETA 90min.
Jordan (PM): Thanks team. Ping me in thread when updated. I'll bring to 3pm sync.
